_comment: Cards that exist only for the batched life-lost trigger test (tests/unit/triggers/test_batched_life_lost.py). Never part of a deck list. `t_bll_tally` is Emet-Selch of the Third Seat's trigger, 'whenever one or more opponents lose life', counting its firings as charge counters; `t_bll_greedy_tally` is the same trigger WITHOUT `batched`, and is the counterfactual that fires once per opponent.

cards.name: Test One-or-More Life Tally
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more opponents lose life, put a charge counter on this enchantment.

abilities.text: Whenever one or more opponents lose life, put a charge counter on this enchantment.

cards.name: Test Greedy Life Tally
cards.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent loses life, put a charge counter on this enchantment.

abilities.text: Whenever an opponent loses life, put a charge counter on this enchantment.
